quote: Self inspections should be conducted in order to monitor the implementation and compliance with Good Manufacturing Practice principles and to propose necessary corrective measures.
statement: Carry out self inspections to monitor how GMP principles are implemented and complied with, and to propose any corrective measures needed.

quote: Personnel matters, premises, equipment, documentation, production, quality control, distribution of the medicinal products, arrangements for dealing with complaints and recalls, and self inspection, should be examined at intervals following a pre-arranged programme in order to verify their conformity with the principles of Quality Assurance.
statement: Examine personnel matters, premises, equipment, documentation, production, quality control, distribution of medicinal products, complaint and recall arrangements, and self inspection itself at intervals under a pre-arranged programme, to verify they conform with Quality Assurance principles.

quote: Self inspections should be conducted in an independent and detailed way by designated competent person(s) from the company.
statement: Have self inspections performed independently and in detail by designated, competent company personnel.

quote: Independent audits by external experts may also be useful.
statement: Optionally use independent audits by external experts in addition.

quote: All self inspections should be recorded.
statement: Keep a record of every self inspection.

quote: Reports should contain all the observations made during the inspections and, where applicable, proposals for corrective measures.
statement: Self inspection reports include every observation made and, where applicable, proposed corrective measures.

quote: Statements on the actions subsequently taken should also be recorded.
statement: Record statements on the actions taken afterwards in response to self inspections.

quote: The self- inspection programme should be designed to detect any shortcomings in the implementation of GMP and to recommend the necessary corrective actions.
statement: Design the self-inspection programme to find any gaps in GMP implementation and to recommend the corrective actions needed.

quote: Self-inspections should be performed routinely
statement: Perform self-inspections routinely.

quote: may be, in addition, performed on special occasions, e.g. in the case of product recalls or repeated rejections, or when an inspection by the health authorities is announced
statement: Optionally perform additional self-inspections on special occasions, for example product recalls, repeated rejections, or an announced health authority inspection.

quote: The team responsible for self-inspection should consist of personnel who can evaluate the implementation of GMP objectively.
statement: Staff the self-inspection team with people able to assess GMP implementation objectively.

quote: All recommendations for corrective action should be implemented.
statement: Implement every corrective action recommendation.

quote: The procedure for self-inspection should be documented
statement: Document the self-inspection procedure.

quote: there should be an effective follow-up programme
statement: Maintain an effective follow-up programme for self-inspections.

quote: Written instructions for self-inspection should be established to provide a minimum and uniform standard of requirements.
statement: Establish written self-inspection instructions that set a minimum, uniform standard of requirements.

quote: These may include questionnaires on GMP requirements covering at least the following items: (a) personnel; (b) premises including personnel facilities; (c) maintenance of buildings and equipment; (d) storage of starting materials and finished products; (e) equipment; (f) production and in-process controls; (g) QC; (h) documentation; (i) sanitation and hygiene; (j) validation and revalidation programmes; (k) calibration of instruments or measurement systems; (l) recall procedures; (m) complaints management; (n) labels control; (o) results of previous self-inspections and any corrective steps taken.
statement: Optionally include GMP questionnaires in the instructions, covering at least personnel; premises including personnel facilities; building and equipment maintenance; storage of starting materials and finished products; equipment; production and in-process controls; QC; documentation; sanitation and hygiene; validation and revalidation programmes; calibration of instruments or measurement systems; recall procedures; complaints management; labels control; and results of previous self-inspections with corrective steps taken.

quote: Management should appoint a self-inspection team consisting of experts in their respective fields who are familiar with GMP.
statement: Management appoints a self-inspection team of subject experts who know GMP.

quote: The members of the team may be appointed from inside or outside the company.
statement: Team members can be appointed from within the company or from outside it.

quote: The frequency with which self-inspections are conducted may depend on company requirements but should preferably be at least once a year.
statement: Set self-inspection frequency according to company needs, preferably at least once a year.

quote: The frequency should be stated in the procedure.
statement: State the self-inspection frequency in the procedure.

quote: A report should be made at the completion of a self-inspection.
statement: Prepare a report when each self-inspection is completed.

quote: The report should include: (a) self-inspection results; (b) evaluation and conclusions; (c) recommended corrective actions.
statement: The self-inspection report covers the results, the evaluation and conclusions, and the recommended corrective actions.

quote: There should be an effective follow-up programme.
statement: Maintain an effective follow-up programme for self-inspection outcomes.

quote: The company management should evaluate both the self-inspection report and the corrective actions as necessary.
statement: Company management reviews the self-inspection report and, as necessary, the corrective actions.

quote: It may be useful to supplement self-inspections with a quality audit.
statement: Optionally supplement self-inspections with a quality audit.

quote: Such audits may also be extended to suppliers and contractors
statement: Optionally extend quality audits to suppliers and contractors.

quote: The person responsible for QC should have responsibility, together with other relevant departments, for approving suppliers who can reliably supply starting and packaging materials that meet established specifications.
statement: The person responsible for QC, with other relevant departments, is responsible for approving suppliers able to reliably provide starting and packaging materials meeting established specifications.

quote: Before suppliers are approved and included in the approved suppliers’ list or specifications, they should be evaluated.
statement: Evaluate suppliers before approving them and adding them to the approved supplier list or specifications.

quote: The evaluation should take into account a supplier’s history and the nature of the materials to be supplied.
statement: Supplier evaluation considers the supplier's history and the nature of the materials it will supply.

quote: If an audit is required, it should determine the supplier’s ability to conform with GMP standards.
statement: If a supplier audit is required, it determines whether the supplier can conform with GMP standards.

statement: Perform regular internal audits on an approved schedule to verify compliance with GMP principles for APIs.

quote: Audit findings and corrective actions should be documented and brought to the attention of responsible management of the firm.
statement: Document audit findings and corrective actions and bring them to the attention of the firm's responsible management.

quote: Agreed corrective actions should be completed in a timely and effective manner.
statement: Complete agreed corrective actions in a timely and effective way.
